bias_targets.methodology: Literature review of existing studies evaluating racial representation, demographic stereotypes, and over-indexing on race in LLM-generated clinical vignettes and medical texts.
Literature review of research examining gender stereotypes and demographic skews in texts generated by large language models for clinical applications.

Literature review discussing disparities in generative AI awareness, internet access, and digital literacy, evaluating how these tools may disproportionately benefit already-privileged patients with higher education and income.
